<subject>coordination with Kalgoorlie</subject>
<body>
I had a conversation with Bryan Wilson and Cynthia Calhoun this morning re: MINTRAC and the Kalgoorlie loading process.

Bryan has generated both a loaded and unloaded wagon list which he will forward so that Port Hedland can review for counterparty contract accuracy. I think that Kalgoorlie can use our newly established procedures as a model. Bryan and others will participate in the 9:30 a.m. conference call Feb 5.

John and Randy: Can you provide Bryan with a copy of the "Ironstone Bulk Logistics" template, or if this has been replaced, a copy of the most recent template? Also, “Karratha Rail” template?

Kyle: Can you provide Bryan and Meredith Green with a copy of the decision tree and freight settlement process flowchart?

If the handouts for tomorrow will be ready and incorporate the above, the handouts are all that Kalgoorlie will need.

Thanks. SS

Katrina Howell  
Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd  
1400 Hay Street, Room 26B43  
Perth, WA 6000
